A340E (2JZ-GTE) AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION - REAR PLANETARY GEAR

D4882
Z05210

2. INSTALL NO.2 THRUST WASHER
(a) Coat the thrust washer with petroleum jelly.
(b) Install the thrust washer onto the rear planetary gear.
HINT: Make sure that the lug shapes match the cutout
portions on the rear planetary gear.

Open End

Guide
AT2494

3. INSTALL NO.2 ONE-WAY CLUTCH
(a) Install the one-way clutch and 2 retainers into the rear
planetary gear, as shown.
HINT: Make sure that the open ends of the guides on the
one-way clutch face upward.

AT5426

(b) Using a screwdriver, install the snap ring.

AT5427

(c) While turning it counterclockwise, install the one-way
clutch inner race to the rear planetary gear.

Free
Lock

Hold
Turn

AT5447

4. CHECK OPERATION OF NO.2 ONE-WAY CLUTCH
Hold the planetary gear and turn the one-way clutch inner
race. The one-way clutch inner race turns freely counter-
clockwise and locks clockwise.
